## Problem

Describe the operator workflow that is difficult today and who is affected.

## Proposed experience

Describe the expected page, controls, loading and error states, and mobile behavior.

## Backend contract

List the required CLIProxyAPI version and Management API endpoints or fields.

## Security and privacy

Explain how credentials and sensitive data should be displayed, copied, or stored.

## Alternatives

List current workarounds and why they are insufficient.

## Validation

Include expected automated tests, supported locales, and screenshots for UI changes.
